text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Flower. For your<n>present, I
attempted to bake those<n>desserts you like.
However...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I do not know why, but the moment I<n>initiated
contact with the oven, it<n>ceased to function entirely.
The<n>mission ended in failure. My sincerest
apologies...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
O-oh, it's not your fault. Don't be too<n>hard on
yourself, Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
A backup plan must be drafted at the<n>current
juncture. I will accept any<n>input, as long as it is
from you.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: My... input? Hmm... Um... Then how<n>about...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
How about you join me in roasting<n>some
marshmallows to eat? We can<n>use a grill instead of
an oven, so you<n>shouldn't run into any issues,
Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Orders received. However... Is today<n>not your
birthday, Flower? Can I<n>really partake in the
consumption of<n>marshmallows?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
O-of course you can! And actually,<n>um, I... like
watching you eat.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
You know how you blow on hot foods<n>before you
eat them? I think it's<n>really cute. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Reassurance acknowledged—adding<n>that cooling
operations are considered<n>cute to database.
